$comment: Cover sheet for :ha-cards-catalog, the `ha-cards` system: Home Assistant cards in Remote Compose, the UI-builder palette the white-labelled builder on ha.coo.ee offers. The inventory lives in @CatalogComponent annotations under ha-cards-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/ha/cards/, and the builder definition in ui-builder.policy.json beside this file. A design system of its own beside `homeassistant-remotecompose` (the :previews sheet of whole converted cards, catalog.spec.json at the repository root): this one is the palette a design is built from — HA card components plus a core of Remote Material 3 — and its starting templates are whole cards for three targets: dashboard cards, Wear widgets and phone launcher widgets. Each sticker pins its own @Preview size; the one breakpoint is the single-column dashboard width the stickers are drawn at. Light mode, the HA default theme the stickers capture in. No referenceKits: there is no published design kit for Home Assistant cards.
title: Home Assistant cards · RemoteCompose
